item.title: Trump repeats promise of $5,000 checks for all adults
item.description: President Trump is promising $5,000 checks for every adult U.S. citizen if Republicans keep control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: Senate GOP investigates OpenAI over Hugging Face breach
item.description: A Republican-led Senate subcommittee overseeing disaster management is examining OpenAI's response to the July Hugging Face breach, according to Axios.

item.title: The contradictory state of AI today
item.description: Two opposing realities coexist: most users see AI as a modestly useful search tool, while many of those building it hold far grander expectations.

item.title: X becomes the AI community's group chat
item.description: Elon Musk bought Twitter citing the need for a common digital town square. Four years on, it functions more as a live group chat for Silicon Valley.
